title: Scan a Label Once, Never Retype the Carbs Again | vitalii.no
description:
Every time a new snack showed up in the kitchen, Artem's parents had to re-read the nutrition label and type its carbohydrate value in by hand. There was no way to save that work for the next time the same product came back, and no way to stop Artem himself from accidentally changing a number his doctor relied on.

A products library now sits behind the calculator. A photo of the label or brochure uploads the original image to storage, and an AI vision pass pulls the carbohydrate value straight off the picture into the product form. Entries are grouped by category with filtering, and edit access checks the signed-in Google account against the parents' allow-list before anyone can change a saved number.

A product only needs to be photographed and labeled once. The next time Artem picks the same snack, its carb count comes from the library instead of a fresh label read — and the kids can browse it without being able to corrupt the numbers the calculator depends on.
